def execute_oracle_false_promise_dota(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Delays damage and healing calculations on an ally, resolving them together after the effect ends.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    # Attach an escrow ledger to the ally for the effect duration.
    # Intercept incoming healing and damage before health commit; record them without applying immediately under configured exceptions.
    # When duration ends, combine recorded values according to the ability's intended order and multiplier rules.
    # Apply the resulting net outcome once; clear ledger and ensure death/disconnect does not duplicate resolution.
    ledger = open_escrow(target, duration)
    on_damage_or_heal(target, lambda event: ledger.defer(event))
    on_effect_end(lambda: settle_ledger_once(ledger, ordered_resolution))
    apply_final_delta_with_death_rules(target, ledger.result)
    close_and_unsubscribe(ledger)
    tx.commit_if_valid(); ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS
